cohort: Term and preterm neonates were compared to adults.
finding: Preterm neonates had reduced neutrophil chemotaxis and chemokinesis compared to term neonates and adults, and mode of delivery and type of anaesthesia also influenced neutrophil chemotaxis.
mod_finding: Neonates born by vaginal delivery had a higher spontaneous and fMLP-stimulated chemotactic response compared to neonates born by cesarean section.
